tree.clientSeesSpace: A client can see this space
tree.clientSeesList: A client can see this list
tree.deleteSpaceBody: Deletes its folders, lists and every task inside. This can't be undone.
tree.deleteFolderBody: Its lists move up to the space — no tasks are deleted.

myWork.title: My work
myWork.nothingFollowed: You are not following anything. Open a task and follow it to keep an eye on it without taking it.
myWork.notAsked: Not asked for — showing open only

task.onlyTeam: Only the team can see this
task.clientCanRead: The client can read this on their own board
task.deleteCommentBody: It stops showing in this thread, and to the client if they could see it.
task.removeAttachmentInUse: It's still referenced from the description — that image will stop loading.
task.removeAttachmentPlain: Removes it from this task's attachment list.
task.noSubtasks: Break this task down into steps, or use a checklist in the description.
task.noColumnForThat: This list has no column for that
task.writeCommentClient: Write a comment… the client reads this thread
task.onlyTeamWillSee: Only the team will see this
task.clientReadsSwitch: The client reads this thread — switch to keep it internal
task.deleteTaskBody: Removes it with its comments and attachments. This can't be undone.
task.withdrawTitle: Take this off the client's board?
task.withdrawBody: They stop seeing it. Its ticket number stays spent — they may already have quoted it — so their numbering keeps a gap.

notes.title: Notes
notes.pickAPage: Pick a page, or create one to start writing.
notes.noPages: No pages yet. Create one to start writing.
notes.restoreFromTrash: You can restore it from the trash.
notes.trashEmpty: Nothing deleted. Pages you delete land here first.
notes.emptyTrashBody: This permanently deletes everything in it. This cannot be undone.
notes.conflictBody: Another device changed this page first — your edit is safe in "{{name}}".
notes.exportNeedsDesktopBody: A browser tab can't write a folder to disk.
notes.typeToSearch: Type to search, or enter a new title to create a page.

board.pickAList: Pick a list on the left, or create one to get started.
board.clientListHint: This list belongs to a client. You'll choose next whether they see it.
board.clientSeesBody: Visible puts it on their board and takes one of their ticket numbers — permanently, even if you withdraw it later. Internal keeps it to the team.

docs.placeholder: What is this for? Links, decisions, how to run it…
docs.staleSinceReview: Nobody has confirmed this in {{days}} days. Whoever reads it next has no way to know whether it still works.
docs.staleNeverReviewed: Written {{days}} days ago and never confirmed since. Whoever reads it next has no way to know whether it still works.
docs.pinEmpty: Pin a line above the board
docs.pinTitle: Pin a line above the board
docs.pinWhy: What somebody needs to know before picking up a card. Leave it empty to remove it.
docs.restoreWhy: This section goes back to how it was on {{date}}. What's there now is kept in the history, so this can be undone too.
docs.openAListFirst: Open a list in #{{where}} to save messages into its docs
docs.conflict: Not saved: someone else got there first
docs.conflictWhy: This section changed while you were writing, so your text was not applied — it would have deleted theirs. Your draft is still here: copy what you need, then reload to see their version.

docTemplates.title: Nothing written here yet
docTemplates.why: Pick a shape to start from, or write from scratch. Only the overview gets filled — the other three stay empty until somebody has something to put in them.
